ROOT-CAUSE PASS, 2026-08-30, run under the root-cause skill AFTER Anthony asked whether one had been run. It had not. The first version of this node asserted a cause borrowed from `dec:idea-do-ideas-form-a-graph-or-only-a-list` rather than tested, and the discriminating measurements below REFUTED IT.

═══ ① WHAT THE FIRST VERSION OF THIS NODE CLAIMED, AND WHY IT WAS WRONG ═══

It said the 2026-08-21 finding *"reproduced itself exactly"* — that finding being 145 idea-Decisions, 12 idea-to-idea edges, 68 whose only edge is their author, and the conclusion *"reflow2 does NOT link ideas... the agent mostly does not."*

MEASURED 2026-08-30 over the whole idea population:

    idea-Decisions                              207   (was 145)
    with >=1 SEMANTIC edge to anything          140   = 68%
    with >=1 edge to another IDEA                83   (was ~12 edges total)
    idea->idea endpoints                        144   (was 12)
    with ZERO semantic edges                     67

🛑 THE POPULATION-LEVEL FINDING DID NOT REPRODUCE. IT IMPROVED BY ROUGHLY AN ORDER OF MAGNITUDE, and almost none of that was this session's ten-odd edges. Sessions between 08-21 and 08-30 did link. "The agent mostly does not link" was true when written and is no longer true. Recording a reproduction would have embalmed a stale finding — which is the failure `invalidated_findings` exists to catch, committed here by the session that had just used that tool on somebody else's stale claim.

What DID recur is one instance: this session drew 2 edges, named 3 more nodes in prose only, and drew them after Anthony asked. That is an anecdote, not the population.

═══ ② THE DISCRIMINATING MEASUREMENT, AND THE ACTUAL FINDING ═══

The skill's step 4 has TWO outcomes: draw the true relations, or record `no_relation_note` — *"what you searched, what was nearest, and why nothing was honestly related"* — which is what separates an idea somebody judged from one nobody opened.

    ideas carrying a `no_relation_note`           2  of 207
    ideas with ZERO edges                        67
    of those 67, how many were noted              0

⭐ SO THE LINKING HALF LARGELY WORKS AND THE JUDGEMENT-RECORDING HALF DOES NOT EXIST IN PRACTICE. Two uses in 207. Every one of the 67 unlinked ideas is silent, so for each of them "nobody looked" and "looked and found nothing" are indistinguishable — exactly the distinction the field was added to preserve.

═══ ③ WHY NOTHING EVER SURFACED THIS — THE THIRD LEG WAS ACCEPTED AWAY ═══

`fact:vocabulary-needs-three-legs-and-a-users-project-gets-none-of-it` states the pattern: vocabulary reaches a design only with A TYPED TOOL + AN INSTRUCTION + A DETECTOR THAT NOTICES ABSENCE. Here:

  ✅ TOOL       `review_relations` exists and REFUSES when given neither links nor a note.
  ✅ INSTRUCTION brainstorm step 4, explicit, with the fabrication hazard spelled out.
  🛑 DETECTOR   `detect_unreviewed_ideas` (detect.rs:4376) EXISTS AND IS SILENT. Confirmed 2026-08-30: `detect_gaps` returns 4 gaps and `unreviewed_ideas` is not among them, against a population of 67.

It is silent because ANTHONY ACCEPTED IT, 2026-08-23, in his own words: *"Accept it. A parked idea legitimately governs nothing yet."* The reasoning on `decision:ack:baa3d7b03a08dedb` is sound and is not being second-guessed here: a `proposed` Decision asserts nothing, and demanding relations from every idea *"would add exactly the ceremony the brainstorm skill exists to remove."*

⚠️ BUT THAT ACKNOWLEDGEMENT ANSWERED A NARROWER QUESTION THAN THE ONE IT NOW SILENCES, and it says so itself: *"It does not say linking ideas is worthless — review_relations exists precisely so a session CAN record a relation or an honest 'nothing was related', and the count is still computed."* It settled whether an unlinked idea is a DEFECT TO PRESS THE USER ABOUT. It did not settle whether anyone should ever learn that the honest-nothing path has been used twice in two hundred.

📌 AND IT WAS WRITTEN TO EXPIRE: *"THE REVIEW EXPIRES BY CONSTRUCTION if the affected set changes... raised at 117 of 166 ideas and stood at 110 of 192 when this was written. If the shape shifts materially the question comes back."* The shape HAS shifted materially and in the good direction — 110 of 192 unreviewed then, 67 of 207 now — and the question has not come back.

═══ ④ THE CAUSE, STATED AS A CLASS ═══

NOT "the agent forgets to link". The cause is that THE DISCIPLINE'S ONLY OBSERVABLE OUTPUT IS AN EDGE, AND AN EDGE IS PRODUCED BY A DOZEN OTHER TOOLS. Compliance is indistinguishable from incidental byproduct: 140 ideas carry edges, and nothing says how many were reviewed rather than merely connected in passing by `governed_by`, `satisfies` or `create_edge`. The one act that would leave positive evidence of a considered judgement — the note — costs a call, produces no visible artifact, and is the only half nobody performs.

That is the same shape as `cap:search-first-at-the-tool`, one step earlier in the same workflow: search-before-you-add sat in five skills, fired only when somebody loaded one, and was fixed by moving it INTO the write tool as a two-sided refusal that cannot be skipped. Link-after-capture has the refusal but nothing compels the call.

═══ ⑤ NOT ESTABLISHED ═══
· How many of the 140 linked ideas were linked THROUGH `review_relations` rather than by other tools. Nothing records which tool drew an edge, so "is the discipline followed?" is not answerable from the graph at all — which may be the more fundamental finding.
· Whether the 67 silent ideas are a problem. Anthony's 08-23 judgement says an unlinked idea is not a defect, and that judgement stands.
· Whether the five edges this session drew on `dec:idea-governance-rides-the-tool-that-does-the-thing` are sound. They were drawn under direct request, and the node sits at degree 5 against the skill's guidance of two or three.
